subject: Close trajectory firming & MAP re-anchoring
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@vertexhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@vertexhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & timeline for evaluation

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Quick update from our side: procurement surfaced a security questionnaire this morning and legal wants a short call to confirm data handling for the eval environment. That adds roughly two weeks to our original acceptance window unless we can provide the additional artifacts this week.

I know the engineering team is ready on your side, but procurement is the blocker — they specifically requested:
- Completed security questionnaire (attached to their email)
- SOC2 evidence and recent pen test summary
- Signed NDA addendum for the eval dataset

Can Redwood accommodate a condensed MAP that prioritizes the security artifacts first and shifts the acceptance milestone out by 10 business days? If you can propose concrete tasks and owners by EOD, I can escalate internally and try to compress approvals.

Thanks,
Erin Walsh
Director, Clinical Integrations
Vertex Health

--
Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.docx (referenced by procurement)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & timeline for evaluation

Thanks Erin — appreciate the heads up.

We can absolutely re-anchor the MAP to keep momentum while we parallelize the compliance deliverables. High level proposal (attached as Proposed_MAP_v2.xlsx):

1) Immediate (this week) — Security priority lane
   - Redwood: ship SOC2 IG- and scope summary + pen test executive summary (owner: Karthik)
   - Vertex: confirm receipt and notify procurement that artifacts are en route (owner: Erin)

2) Days 3–7 — Technical eval & smoke test (non-production)
   - Redwood: provide ephemeral eval environment + onboarding guide (owner: Ben)
   - Vertex: schedule 60m technical review with integration team (owner: Erin)

3) Days 8–15 — Procurement close
   - Vertex: return signed NDA addendum + procurement PO (owner: Procurement)
   - Redwood: standby for quick contract redlines; offer expedited legal turn (owner: Marissa)

4) Acceptance window moved from 2027-06-21 to 2027-07-05 (target final acceptance)

We will also maintain a risk ledger (risk_gap_log.csv attached) that tracks blockers, owners, and mitigation. If Vertex needs an aggressive alternative, we can offer a temporary limited-access eval (on strict T&Cs) to keep engineering validation on track while procurement completes paperwork.

Can you confirm the PO timing and whether procurement will accept the SOC2 summary + pen test summary in lieu of the full evidence bundle? If yes, I’ll push a DocuSign for the NDA addendum and schedule the tech review.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Proposed_MAP_v2.xlsx, risk_gap_log.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & timeline for evaluation

Ben — quick internal note before we lock the proposal. Two items to consider:

- Legal: we can fast-track the NDA addendum review if procurement agrees to the summary artifacts approach, but we should include a 30-day data-use rollback clause in the addendum. I can draft language and have our counsel pre-clear it.

- Commercial: given the timeline shift, we should offer a one-time onboarding credit (up to $5k) to preserve goodwill and reduce the friction of the schedule slip. If Sales Ops signs off, we can include it in the DocuSign bundle as an amendment.

Karthik — can you confirm the pen test exec summary is cleared for external distribution? If not, what minimal statement can we share right away?

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success (Enterprise) — Redwood
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@vertexhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & timeline for evaluation

Erin — thanks, attaching a concise plan and next steps so procurement has clear checkpoints. I also linked the HubSpot plan for your reference: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/VRTX-2027-001

Quoted for context:
> "Can Redwood accommodate a condensed MAP that prioritizes the security artifacts first and shifts the acceptance milestone out by 10 business days?"

Yes — proposed mutual action plan (compressed):
- Day 0 (today): Redwood sends SOC2 scope note + pen test executive summary (Karthik) — ACTION: confirm receipt by EOD
- Day 1: Redwood shares NDA addendum (DocuSign) + onboarding guide (Ben) — ACTION: Vertex to sign NDA addendum or flag redlines within 48 hours
- Day 2–4: Tech review + smoke tests (Ben + Grace) — ACTION: schedule 60m call, attendees: Vertex integrations, Redwood platform eng
- Day 5–10: Procurement returns PO + final legal accept (Vertex procurement) — ACTION: procurement to provide expected PO date
- Day 11–15: Final cutover prep and limited pilot (both teams)

New target acceptance: 2027-07-05. Fallback: if PO not received by Day 10, we can keep the technical eval active but behind a data-limited tunnel (read-only) until legal clears full access.

Commercial concession: pending Sales Ops approval, we can offer a one-time $5,000 onboarding credit if Vertex signs within the re-anchored window. Marissa will include the credit in the DocuSign package.

Next steps I’m executing now:
- Karthik: push SOC2 summary + pen test exec summary to Erin (attached in separate email thread if needed).
- Marissa: prepare DocuSign NDA addendum + credit clause.
- Grace: propose 3x 60m slots for the technical review on Mon/Tue next week.

If that works, Erin — please reply with the procurement PO ETA and the preferred time for the tech review.

Best,
Ben

--
Attachments referenced: Proposed_MAP_v2.xlsx, risk_gap_log.csv
DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/envelopes/ABC123

To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@vertexhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & timeline for evaluation

Ben / team — this looks good and appreciated. Procurement confirmed they will accept the SOC2 summary + pen test executive summary as interim evidence, and they can return a PO by 2027-06-17 if there are no major contract redlines.

We’ll sign the NDA addendum today (I’ll route to Procurement) and I’ve attached the PO stub that shows tentative timelines. Please go ahead and schedule the technical review for Tue 2027-06-08 at 11:00am PT — attendees from our side: myself, integrations lead, and a procurement stakeholder.

Thanks — Erin

--
